## Load packages

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
devtools::load_all()
library(rlang)

```

## Load the data

```{r}

dat_age <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

```

## Fit model for Test crosses: all four lines

```{r}

## Filter the data
dat_test_age <- dat_age |>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("AmxAm", "BalxBal", "AmxBal", "BalxAm", "TrentoxTrento", "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "RennesxAm", "AmxRennes", "RennesxRennes", "AmxPar6","Par6xPar6", "Par6xAm"))

dat_test_age <- dat_test_age |> dplyr::filter(Cross == "Test cross W- x W+" & !is.na(MaleAge))

table(dat_test_age$Male, dat_test_age$MaleAge)

m_test_no_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + Male, data = dat_test_age, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), ziformula = ~1, dispformula = ~1, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

m_test_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + Male + MaleAge, data = dat_test_age, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), ziformula = ~1, dispformula = ~1, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

### Convergence and model comparison

m_test_no_age$sdr$pdHess
m_test_age$sdr$pdHess

summary(m_test_age)
logLik(m_test_no_age)
logLik(m_test_age)

anova(m_test_no_age, m_test_age)
MuMIn::model.sel(m_test_no_age, m_test_age, rank = "AICc")

b_test <- boot_age(m_test_age, dat_test_age)

```

## Fit model for Control cross 3: all four lines

```{r}

dat_control_age <- dat_age |>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("AmxAm", "BalxBal", "AmxBal", "BalxAm", "TrentoxTrento", "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "RennesxAm", "AmxRennes", "RennesxRennes", "AmxPar6","Par6xPar6", "Par6xAm"))

dat_control_age <- dat_control_age |> dplyr::filter(Cross == "Control cross 3 W+ x W+" & !is.na(MaleAge))

table(dat_control_age$Male, dat_control_age$MaleAge)

m_control_no_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + Male, data = dat_control_age, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), ziformula = ~1, dispformula = ~1, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

m_control_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + Male + MaleAge, data = dat_control_age, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), ziformula = ~1, dispformula = ~1, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

### Convergence and model comparison

m_control_no_age$sdr$pdHess
m_control_age$sdr$pdHess

summary(m_control_age)
logLik(m_control_no_age)
logLik(m_control_age)

anova(m_control_no_age, m_control_age)
MuMIn::model.sel(m_control_no_age, m_control_age, rank = "AICc")

b_control <- boot_age(m_control_age, dat_control_age)

```

## Fit model for Test crosses: CI-lines only (Bal and Trento)

```{r}
dat_CI_age <- dat_test_age |> dplyr::filter(Male %in% c("Bal", "Trento"))

table(dat_CI_age$Male, dat_CI_age$MaleAge)

m_CI_no_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + Male, data = dat_CI_age, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), ziformula = ~1, dispformula = ~1, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

m_CI_age <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + Male + MaleAge, data = dat_CI_age, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), ziformula = ~1, dispformula = ~1, weights = sum_eggcount_corr)

m_CI_no_age$sdr$pdHess
m_CI_age$sdr$pdHess

summary(m_CI_age)
logLik(m_CI_no_age)
logLik(m_CI_age)

anova(m_CI_no_age, m_CI_age)
MuMIn::model.sel(m_CI_no_age, m_CI_age, rank = "AICc")

b_CI <- boot_age(m_CI_age, dat_CI_age) 
```

## Table S10

```{r}

TableS10a <- rbind(model_sel_age(m_test_no_age,    m_test_age,    "Test crosses, all lines"),
                   model_sel_age(m_CI_no_age,      m_CI_age,      "Test crosses, Bal and Trento"),
                   model_sel_age(m_control_no_age, m_control_age, "Control cross 3, all lines"))
names(TableS10b)[names(TableS10b) == "dAICc"] <- "ΔAICc"
names(TableS10b)[names(TableS10b) == "Chisq"] <- "χ² (LRT)"


TableS10b <- rbind(cbind(Type = "Test cross W- x W+",      b_test$pred),
                   cbind(Type = "Control cross 3 W+ x W+", b_control$pred)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Male = factor(Male, levels = c("Trento", "Bal", "Rennes", "Par6"))) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Male, Type != "Test cross W- x W+", MaleAge) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Line = as.character(Male), `Cross (♀ × ♂)` = sub("x", " × ", CrossType),
                   `Cross type` = Type, `Male age (days)` = MaleAge, n,
                   `Mean hatch rate` = est, `Lower 95% CI` = lo, `Upper 95% CI` = hi)


TableS10c <- rbind(b_test$slope, b_CI$slope, b_control$slope) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Analysis = c("Test crosses, all lines", "Test crosses, Bal and Trento",
                                "Control cross 3, all lines"),
                   Crosses  = c("W− ♀ × W+ ♂", "W− ♀ × W+ ♂", "W+ ♀ × W+ ♂"),
                   n,
                   `Odds ratio per day` = exp(est),
                   `Lower 95% CI`       = exp(lo),
                   `Upper 95% CI`       = exp(hi),
                   n_ok)

TableS10a; TableS10b; TableS10c

## Export files
readr::write_excel_csv(TableS10a, file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS10a_model_AICc.csv"), delim = ";")
readr::write_excel_csv(TableS10b, file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS10b_hatchrate_age.csv"), delim = ";")
readr::write_excel_csv(TableS10c, file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS10c_age_effect.csv"), delim = ";")

```
